incorporationAct: Companies and Allied Matters Act (Corporate Affairs Commission, Nigeria)
headquarters: Plot 2, Toluwani Street, Peace Avenue, Off Iworoko Road, Ado Ekiti, Ekiti State, Nigeria
overview: SPES Swiftpace Engineering Solutions Limited is an engineering, construction and consultancy company based in Ado Ekiti, Ekiti State, Nigeria. Operating across architecture, building construction, civil and structural engineering, construction management, consultancy and allied services, the company delivers practical solutions grounded in technical precision and quality workmanship.
extendedOverview: The company’s service offering brings together design-related capabilities, engineering input, construction activity and project coordination. Its stated approach places emphasis on technical precision, professional coordination, quality workmanship, functional design and effective project delivery.
vision: To become a recognised and trusted engineering and construction company, distinguished by technical excellence, innovative thinking, quality project delivery and sustainable contributions to the built environment.
mission: To provide professional, efficient and innovative engineering, construction and consultancy services through sound technical practices, effective project management and a commitment to quality, safety and client satisfaction.
